text:
kai: Customer used quickstart curl, saw "Request failed (402)" and assumed bad key. They joined via SSO invite and never hit onboarding.

anya: Can you paste the raw response?

kai: Body: {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"workspace_incomplete"}}

sam: That's an onboarding gate. Short-term support note: ask user to finish billing at https://console.redwood-inference.test/onboarding.

devex-bot: Tracking: DEVEX-841 - surface onboarding reason in CLI/SDK and include an onboarding_url in error payload. Workaround doc: https://go.redwood/onboard-ssogap

anya: Proposal: API add onboarding_required + onboarding_url when org.state != active; SDKs map to a WorkspaceOnboardingRequired error so apps can show a CTA. I'll open the PR.
